assumptions.statement: Official boundary, key-area polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provisional intake and design discussion; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All site boundary, key-area, land-use, building, road, green-space, public-space, and phasing areas are derived from provisional rough polygons.
assumptions.impact: Areas and ratios must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual design containers, not current or approved building data.
assumptions.impact: No parcel-level demolition, renovation, ownership, or construction-scale conclusion can be drawn.

assumptions.statement: Heritage, blue-line, flood-control, and public-safety constraints are not verified from official data.
assumptions.impact: Public-space and landmark proposals must remain conservative and be reviewed by professional teams.
